description:
Hiking and ski trails that leads from the Barkerville Historic Townsite up a portion of the Cariboo Wagon Road, past the Richfield Courthouse up to Groundhog Lake and Mt Agnes.

This is also a WINTER ONLY motorized trail, you can expect to see snowmobiles / groomers in the winter months.

There is a warming hut at the lake.
directions:
From Quesenl, head East on Hwy 26 to Barkerville. Park in the main parking area, follow the road along Williams Creek, which turns into the trail at the end of town.

While in the area spend some time at the Barkerville Historic Townsite.
